themes.title: Fix the CI-breaking SECURITY_VERSION assertion and correct stale version/tool/command docs
themes.rationale: tests/e2e/test_plan32_integration.py::test_security_version_is_0_5_0 asserts SECURITY_VERSION == '0.5.0' but the shipped value is '0.6.0' (verified live: pytest FAILS today under testpaths=['tests']). This is a live red bar that blocks any clean release run. The same 0.5.0 drift exists in README.md:272, and the same family of doc-accuracy gaps (security tool tables omitting business_logic + capsule_scope, the well-known SKILL.md missing the Skill Verifier + Trace Intelligence sections, stale capsule/index notes) are all pure accuracy fixes against an authoritative source. Bundled because they are the highest-leverage release-prep items and touch a disjoint, doc-heavy fileset that will not collide with any code worktree.
themes.expected_benefit: Restores green CI (the test_plan32 assertion is the only failing test verified in this pass), and makes every operator-facing version/tool/command surface agree with the authoritative sources (security/version.py = 0.6.0, security/tools/_registry.py = 9 tools, the installed skill/SKILL.md, and the shipped capsule/trace-discover CLI). Removes confident-but-wrong documentation right before a release.
themes.safety_proof: SECURITY_VERSION 0.6.0 is the named three-version invariant; security/version.py:32 is authoritative and web docs (tiers.md:8, versioning.md:74) already say 0.6.0 — only README:272 and the test assertion are stale, so this aligns docs to truth rather than changing behaviour. The test only asserts a constant value and its 0.5.0 value contradicts the FEATURE_MAP invariant; fix to 0.6.0 (do NOT delete test_full_stack_integration — its EntityMap/ParseOutcome/StateManager/HF-token/TruffleHog paths run live and removing it is unnecessary scope). Security tool tables: tiers.md and _registry.py both list all 9 tools (business_logic, capsule_scope verified present); README/commands.md are the truncated copies. Well-known SKILL.md delta (0 Skill Verifier hits vs 13 in skill/SKILL.md) maps to real shipped commands in cli/skill_verifier.py and cli/trace.py (--waste/--run-intel/compare confirmed). No CLI surface, schema, security order, or event-log ref is touched.
themes.scope_boundary: OUT: do NOT delete test_full_stack_integration or any test logic (only update the one constant); do NOT bump any actual version number; do NOT touch the security tool registry code or pipeline order; do NOT rewrite CHANGELOG history beyond adding the [Unreleased] header wrapper above the existing MERGED sections.

themes.expected_benefit: Removes ~1700+ LOC of dead/prototype code plus a broken dev shim and a noop build hook from the shipped tree, eliminating the structural confusion of 'three capture sources' (only two are live) and a build hook that does nothing. Leaves git history as the recovery path.
themes.safety_proof: http_proxy: grep confirms zero importers outside the module; the only references are doc-comments in otlp/__init__.py:5 and context_tree/contract.py:87. The capture_method='proxy' constant lives in context_tree/contract.py (schema vocab, NOT the module) and MUST be kept so the frozen CAPTURE_METHOD_VALUES set is unchanged — only delete the module dir and de-reference the doc-comment text. scripts/archive and badge-generator: grep across .py/.toml/.md/.yaml/Makefile returns zero callers. otc: hardcoded PYTHONPATH to a worktree confirmed absent ('No such file or directory'); canonical shim is otd. hatch_build.py: gutted to a bare noop in 2e6edaa6a6; the load-bearing skill/ force-include is declarative under [tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel.force-include] and independent of the hook — removing the [tool.hatch.build.hooks.custom] entry + file + the 3 noop-asserting tests changes no wheel contents (verify wheel build after). build-viewer: not invoked by build/release; viewer decommissioned. No VISIBLE or HIDDEN CLI command, event-log ref, security order, or schema field is touched.
themes.scope_boundary: OUT: do NOT remove or alter any CAPTURE_METHOD_* constant or the CAPTURE_METHOD_VALUES frozenset (the 'proxy' literal stays); do NOT touch capture/otlp/ runtime code beyond deleting the dead doc-comment reference; do NOT remove scripts/ot-story or scripts/verify_blame_roundtrip.py; do NOT alter the wheel's skill/ force-include block.

themes.title: Delete dead CLI commands/modules and the parallel _cli forwarding shims; prune the stale legacy drop-list
themes.rationale: The CLI layer carries multiple disjoint dead-code clusters that all converge on cli/__init__.py and a small set of side-effect modules, so they must be ONE theme to avoid worktree collisions on __init__.py. Verified: trace.py:1852-2159 defines trace_show/reject/reset/discard as never-registered commands (tests/cli/test_cli_commands.py:149-173 already locks in that show/reject/reset/discard return 'No such command'); the __init__.py drop-list (4053-4075) contains 8 no-op entries for names never registered at root; publish.py and import_hf.py each register exactly ONE command (push/pull) that is immediately dropped; and 5 side-effect modules (publish/inspect/_debug/import_hf/installers, plus trace.py) carry 5-9 identical `return _cli.*` forwarding shims each (verified counts: publish 9, inspect 7, _debug 7, import_hf 5, installers 6).
themes.expected_benefit: Removes ~308 dead lines from trace.py, ~993 lines across publish.py+import_hf.py, ~70 lines of forwarding-shim boilerplate, and 8 dead drop-list strings from the import-time hot path. Collapses the 'which emit_json' confusion (trace.py's duplicate _emit_json vs emit_json) into direct imports from cli/__init__.
themes.safety_proof: trace_show/reject/reset/discard are never added to any group (grep in __init__.py returns nothing) and tests/cli/test_cli_commands.py:149-173 already asserts they are absent — deletion is locked-in-safe. The 8 drop-list no-ops (show/reject/reset/discard/export/assess/blame/resume) pop keys that were never set (silent KeyError today); 'blame' stays a GROUP under trail_group untouched. publish.py/import_hf.py register only the dropped push/pull (verified: single @main.command each, dropped at __init__.py:4058-4059; migration journey migration-u-ds-3-pull-removed.toml asserts removal). BLOCKER handled in-scope: tests/publish/test_publish_flow.py imports _persist_push_target/_resolve_push_target/_resolve_push_visibility from cli.publish — relocate those three pure config/remote-resolution helpers into core/publish_flow.py (or a core module) and update the test import BEFORE deleting publish.py, so no live reference remains. Side-effect imports at __init__.py:2737-2738 for publish/import_hf must be removed in lockstep. Every other VISIBLE+HIDDEN command stays registered; no schema, security order, or event-log ref touched.
themes.scope_boundary: OUT: do NOT change any live command's behaviour, flags, or output; do NOT touch the publish/HF uploader CORE logic (publish/huggingface/*) — only relocate the 3 config-resolution helpers; do NOT remove drop-list entries that still drop real legacy roots (list/add/redact/web/tui/remote/stats/log/graph/llm-review); do NOT split trace.py into new files here (file-split is explicitly deferred).

themes.title: Consolidate duplicated core query/time helpers and remove no-op stub loops, with safe naming normalizations
themes.rationale: The core layer has high-confidence, low-risk duplication and dead code that does NOT require splitting the giant files: 8+ byte-identical _utc_now() copies, byte-identical _fts_query/_page_offset/_recency_weighted_sort across trace_index.py and search_projection.py (with a SILENT regex divergence in _terms already present: trace_index uses [a-zA-Z0-9_./-] vs search_projection [A-Za-z0-9_@./-]), two no-op stub loops in _rebuild_index_locked (_insert_map_node/_insert_map_edge return None), dead functions in core/workflow.py (stage_description, stage_label, legacy_mode_for_review_policy, review_policy_from_legacy_mode — verified zero call sites), and the leaky bucket_backend->bucket_store path-helper import (six helpers actually defined in bucket_layout). Grouped because they all live in core/ and are pure consolidation/removal with no behaviour change.
themes.expected_benefit: Removes ~80-120 lines of verbatim duplication and ~25 lines of dead stubs/functions, and crucially fixes the latent divergence risk (the _terms regex has ALREADY drifted between the two search backends) by establishing a single source of truth for the pagination/tokenization contract. Tightens bucket_backend's dependency surface from the 3205-line bucket_store down to its two genuinely-owned symbols.
themes.safety_proof: All consolidated helpers are private (underscore) and have zero external importers (verified). Behaviour-preserving: pick ONE canonical _terms regex and assert search-eval parity stays GREEN — the existing tests/search_eval harness + the trace-query parity suite (test_trace_query_parity.py, test_plan056) are the guard. The two _insert_map_* stubs return None and are called only at trace_index.py:309/311; the refresh path already omits them, so the rebuild path is the only one paying for no-op iterations — removal is provably side-effect-free. workflow.py dead funcs: grep confirms zero call sites for stage_description/stage_label/legacy_mode_for_review_policy/review_policy_from_legacy_mode (config.py inlines the migration rather than calling them); drop them from __all__ and the noqa import in trace.py:19. bucket_backend path helpers are re-exports of bucket_layout definitions — importing from the defining module is identity-preserving. No CLI surface, schema, security order, gzip mtime=0, or event-log ref changes. This theme does NOT split files, so it does not collide with any large-file-split work (deliberately none scheduled).
themes.scope_boundary: OUT: do NOT split trace_index.py / bucket_store.py / trails/sync.py into new modules (file-splitting is intentionally excluded as too risky for a single overnight PR and would collide with this theme on the same files); do NOT rename workflow.py vs workflows.py (deferred — touches many import sites + docs); do NOT change the canonical search ranking semantics, only deduplicate; pick the regex that keeps search-eval GREEN and document the choice.
